mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Library
mods.description: Shared library code and runtime helpers used by the BuildCraft Community Edition modules.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Core
mods.description: Core BuildCraft content: common items, gears, engines, markers and shared gameplay systems.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Factory
mods.description: Factory machines and fluid infrastructure, including tanks, pumps, mining wells and processing blocks.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Transport
mods.description: Item, fluid and power pipes, gates, wires, facades, plugs and transport automation.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Energy
mods.description: Oil, fuels, power generation and energy-related BuildCraft mechanics.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Builders
mods.description: Builder module content such as quarries, fillers, frames, markers, templates and construction machines.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Silicon
mods.description: Silicon technology: lasers, assembly tables, integration tables, programming tables, chipsets and gates.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Robotics
mods.description: Robots, docking stations, redstone boards, zones and robotic automation.

mods.name: BuildCraft Community Edition - Compat
mods.description: Optional cross-mod content for BuildCraft Community Edition, including the Forestry Apiarist's Pipe.

block: Charges compatible items using BuildCraft power
Combines compatible items using integration recipes
Constructs structures from Blueprints and Templates
Converts Forge Energy (FE) into Minecraft Joules (MJ)
Converts Minecraft Joules (MJ) into Forge Energy (FE)
Creates and edits work zones for Robots
Fills or clears marked areas using selectable patterns
Records marked areas as Blueprints or Templates
Stores and manages Blueprints and Templates
Use a Wrench to change the output rate.
item: Use only for testing! Leaks secrets.
